questions.q_en: Select the related word from the given alternatives: Lion : Roar :: Horse : ?
questions.q_hi: दिए गए विकल्पों में से संबंधित शब्द का चयन करें: शेर : दहाड़ :: घोड़ा : ?
questions.explanation: Lion roars, similarly Horse neighs. (शेर दहाड़ता है, उसी प्रकार घोड़ा हिनहिनाता है।)

questions.q_en: If a + b = 5 and ab = 6, find the value of a² + b².
questions.q_hi: यदि a + b = 5 और ab = 6 है, तो a² + b² का मान ज्ञात करें।
questions.explanation:
(a+b)² = a² + b² + 2ab 
 => 5² = a² + b² + 2(6) 
 => 25 = a² + b² + 12 
 => a² + b² = 13

questions.q_en: Who wrote the book 'Discovery of India'?
questions.explanation: The Discovery of India was written by Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru during his imprisonment in 1942–1946.
